biggest_catch: The $150/$160 day rates already include training-class pay; workers report 5:30am and must stay past the 7:30pm poll close to close the precinct.
catches: Must be a registered voter in Jefferson County willing to go to any precinct.
Each precinct staffs equal Democrats and Republicans; independents may serve for either party.
Pay is all-inclusive: $150 PEO / $160 VLM includes training class; VLM also includes mileage and supply pickup/return.
Time is 840 min through the 7:30pm poll close; closing the precinct runs beyond that but its duration is not published.

c1.evidence: Jefferson County Board of Elections official page (boe.ohio.gov/jefferson).

c2.evidence: PEO $150/day including training class; VLM $160 plus mileage including training and supply pickup/return.

c3.evidence: No fee to apply or serve.

eligibility: Registered voter in Jefferson County, OH; willing to work any precinct; declares party alignment (independent may serve for either party); completes training.
notes: All-inclusive day rate; training pay is bundled into the $150/$160 (separate pre-election class, duration unstated, not extra). Time is 840 min minimum (5:30am-7:30pm); precinct closing beyond 7:30pm is mandatory but duration unstated.
numeric_basis: payout from official terms ($150-$160 flat day rate, training pay bundled in); time: report 5:30am, polls close 7:30pm = 840 min minimum; precinct closing after 7:30pm mandatory, duration unstated (unbounded above); training class duration unstated (pay bundled in rate)
payout_quote: You will report to the polling place at 5:30 a.m. to help set up the precinct for voting. The polls open at 6:30 a.m. You will be permitted 1 hour for lunch. The polls close at 7:30 p.m. All workers must stay to help close the precinct. The pay for a Precinct Election Official is $150 for the day; this includes the pay for attending the training class. The Voting Location Manager, the person responsible for picking up the supplies used on Election Day, receives $160 plus mileage; this also includes the pay for attending the training class and payment for picking up and returning Election Day supplies.
payout_value_note: Flat day rate: $150 Precinct Election Official (includes training pay); $160 Voting Location Manager + mileage (includes training and supply-run pay).

steps: Be a registered voter in Jefferson County, OH and willing to work any precinct.
Submit the poll worker application (lookup.boe.ohio.gov link on the county page) or call (740) 283-8522.
Complete the training before the election.
Report at 5:30am Election Day; stay through the 7:30pm close and help close the precinct.
timing: Election Day (5:30am until precinct close, after 7:30pm); training in advance.
